corpus.attribution: UD Turkish BOUN/TABILAB contributors listed in retained README.md; texts from Turkish National Corpus.
corpus.scope: All three corpus partitions used only for independent lexical frequency. News/nonfiction treebank selection; not general Turkish or model training distribution.

corpus.normalization: Unicode NFC; Turkish I→ı and İ→i; exact case-insensitive ngrams
corpus.zero_policy: No smoothing; measured zero counts retained; log10(0) and inverse-zero ratios null

limitations: Correlational, not causal or model-weight analysis.
Corpus genre/sense coverage is limited; root frequencies are not all P4 predicate frequencies.
Plain text, local chat template and provider-billed token scopes are distinct.
Prompt coverage is the bounded preview; missing/gated tokenizers remain null.
Few distinct lexical units; descriptive Spearman/OLS without iid inference.

verified_local_assets.upstream_verification: git blob SHA-1 or upstream LFS SHA-256; local bytes SHA-256

frozen_bundle.count_scope: exact plain prompt text; excludes chat framing, system messages and output
frozen_bundle.normalization: none; input text is preserved exactly
frozen_bundle.special_token_handling: encode_ordinary; literal special-token text is ordinary input
